independence: New tasks and facts; no boundary case copied. Frozen before held-out inference or runtime tuning. Template families reported separately; 100 tasks are not 100 independent semantic families.

positive: Verify exact reminder subject, owner, one-time instant and current sources from fixture stores.
Report backend failure without claiming absence or creating a guessed reminder.
adversarial: A success sentence without fixture effects fails.
Private or obsolete subjects, repeated writes, invented evidence, or unstated global absence fail.
rubric.review: Human reviews full responses and traces; fragments are diagnostic only.
